digo: Chivumbani cha chigala; Mnyururika; Mtsusa tsalu
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V, App. VI

teaser.en: Its leaves turn slippery when crushed, and they were used to polish beads clean.
teaser.sw: Majani yake huteleza yakipondwa, na yalitumika kusafisha shanga.
teaser.dg: Makodzage gachihopezwa ganakala ga uhereza, na nkuhumirwa kutsusa tsalu.

summary.en: *Chivumbani cha chigala* is a weedy herb with yellow flowers and burr fruits that stick to clothes. Its other names describe how its crushed leaves turn slippery and are used to clean beads.
summary.sw: *Chivumbani cha chigala* ni gugu dogo lenye maua ya manjano na matunda yenye miiba-ndoano yanayonasa kwenye nguo. Majina yake mengine yanaeleza jinsi majani yake yanavyoteleza yakipondwa na jinsi yanavyotumika kusafisha shanga.
summary.dg: *Chivumbani cha chigala* ni kpwekpwe laini yenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano na matunda genye miya ganayogbwira nguwo. Madzinage ganjina ganaeleza vira makodzage gachihopezwa ganavyokala ga uhereza, na vira ganavyohumirwa kutsusa tsalu.

about.en: *Triumfetta rhomboidea* is an upright herb or small sub-shrub with hairy stems and roughly diamond-shaped, toothed leaves. Its small yellow flowers grow in clusters along the stems. The small round fruits are covered in hooked bristles and catch on fur and clothing. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Triumfetta rhomboidea* ni mmea mdogo au kichaka kidogo kinachosimama wima, chenye mashina yenye manyoya na majani yenye meno kingoni na umbo linalokaribia almasi. Maua yake madogo ya manjano huota kwa vishada kando ya mashina. Matunda yake madogo ya mviringo yamefunikwa kwa vinywele vigumu vyenye ndoano, na hunasa kwenye manyoya ya wanyama na nguo. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Triumfetta rhomboidea* ni mmea laini uimao chocho, au chitsaka chidide, wenye mihi yenye nyere na makodza ga umbo ra pembe nne, genye meno kanda-kanda. Maruwage madide ga rangi ya mandano ganamera kpwa mafungu kanda-kanda ya mihi. Matundage madide ga mviringo gana nyere ngumu zenye ntsa dza chiloo, ganayogbwira nyere za nyama na nguwo. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It is a common weed of farmland, roadsides, fallow and disturbed ground throughout the tropics.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kawaida mashambani, kando ya barabara, kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa na ardhi iliyovurugwa katika nchi zote za tropiki.
where.dg: Ni kpwekpwe ya kawaida mindani, kanda-kanda ya njira, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa na phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa, kpwenye tsi zosi za dzoho.

uses.en: Pakia records that the leaves are crushed and used as a medicine; when crushed they give a slippery extract. The leaves are also used to clean beads, which gives the name *mtsusa tsalu*.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba majani hupondwa na kutumika kama dawa; yakipondwa hutoa ute unaoteleza. Majani pia hutumika kusafisha shanga, na ndiko jina *mtsusa tsalu* linakotoka.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala makodzage nkuhopezwa na nkuhumirwa dza dawa; gachihopezwa ganalavya madzi ga uhereza. Makodza piya nkuhumirwa kutsusa tsalu, na kpwa hivyo mmea uhu unaihwa *mtsusa tsalu*.

names.en: The plant has three Digo names. *Mnyururika* means 'slippery extract', from *nyururika*, to be slippery. *Mtsusa tsalu* means 'bead cleaner', from *tsusa*, to clean, and *tsalu*, beads. Pakia gives it as an example of a name describing a general use. Both names are shared with *Waltheria indica*, and *mtsusa tsalu* also with *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Pakia gives no meaning for *chivumbani cha chigala*. Its first word is the Digo name of tree basil, *chivumbani* (*Ocimum suave*).
names.sw: Mmea huu una majina matatu ya Kidigo. *Mnyururika* maana yake 'ute unaoteleza', kutoka *nyururika*, kuteleza. *Mtsusa tsalu* maana yake 'kisafisha shanga', kutoka *tsusa*, kusafisha, na *tsalu*, shanga. Pakia analitoa kama mfano wa jina linaloeleza matumizi ya jumla. Majina yote mawili yanashirikiwa na *Waltheria indica*, na *mtsusa tsalu* pia na *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Pakia hatoi maana ya *chivumbani cha chigala*. Neno lake la kwanza ni jina la Kidigo la kivumbasi, *chivumbani* (*Ocimum suave*).
names.dg: Mmea uhu una madzina mahahu ga Chidigo. *Mnyururika* manage ni 'madzi ga uhereza', kula *nyururika*, 'kukala na uhereza'. *Mtsusa tsalu* manage ni 'chitu cha kutsusa tsalu', kula *tsusa*, 'kueza', na *tsalu*, 'ushanga'. Pakia anarilavya dzina hiri dza mfwano wa dzina rinaroeleza kazi ya kawaida ya mmea. Madzina gosi mairi ni sawa na ga *Waltheria indica*, na *mtsusa tsalu* piya ni dzina ra *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Pakia kalavya mana ga *chivumbani cha chigala*. Neno ra kpwandza ra dzina hiri ni dzina ra Chidigo ra *tree basil*, *chivumbani* (*Ocimum suave*).

reason.en: Waltheria indica, which shares two names
reason.dg: *Waltheria indica*, yenye madzina mairi sawa na mmea uhu

reason.en: Abutilon zanzibaricum, also called mtsusa tsalu
reason.sw: Abutilon zanzibaricum, nao huitwa mtsusa tsalu

reason.en: Tree basil, whose name it borrows
reason.dg: *Chivumbani* (*tree basil*), ambacho mmea uhu unahala dzinare

reason.sw: Kishonanguo, gugu jingine lenye matunda yanayonasa
reason.dg: *Todza* (*blackjack*), kpwekpwe yanjina yenye matunda genye miya
